findings.reason: The cited evidence confirms the degradation and its nationwide impact, but does not prove the causal direction (that the core caused the nationwide spikes).
T1, T2, and ALR-0035 all explicitly state the start time as 2026-09-24 10:45 for the nationwide latency deviation and anomaly.
T8 shows the specific values (92.7%, 88.7 ms) and onset time (10:45), and ANM-000322 confirms the drop details.
T3 and ALM-000525 both confirm the alarm ID, type, node, raise time (10:52), and clear time (12:05).
T5 and T6 explicitly report no changes or maintenance windows on CORE-DNS-01 and its parents during the specified time window.
